recommendation: Implement systematic immunization status review and reminder systems
implementation_steps: Systematically review immunization status at every patient encounter
Use EHR prompts to identify patients due for vaccines
Coordinate reminder/recall systems using phone, text, and mail
Facilitate scheduling and address barriers like transportation or cost
evidence_summary: Systematic immunization status review and reminder systems have been shown to improve vaccination rates by 8-9% (risk ratio 1.28, 95% CI 1.23-1.35) across multiple studies and populations.
citation: A Review of the Key Factors to Improve Adult Immunization Coverage Rates
